$comment: SE3112 – Code Quality & Metrics. Thresholds, remediation model and reviewed security hotspots used by quality-gate.mjs.

ratchet.$comment: Clean-as-you-code: legacy debt is tolerated, new debt is not. Lower these numbers whenever debt is paid off.

reviewedHotspots.justification: WHERE clause is assembled only from constant fragments in BuildAdminFilters; every user value (dates, status, table number, booking reference) is bound as a MySqlParameter. Column list is a const.
IN (...) list contains generated placeholder names @Id0..@IdN only; the ids themselves are bound as parameters and come from the database, not from a request.
